CAG only audits — it does NOT enforce recovery.

items: CAG has no authority to enforce the recovery of disallowed public expenditure.
Government policy decisions lie strictly outside the jurisdiction of CAG's questioning.
CAG's audit functions mainly after the expenditure has already been incurred.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The CAG acts strictly as an auditor and lacks executive power to enforce fund recovery.
CAG cannot question the wisdom or merits of government policy decisions.
The role of CAG is largely ex-post, functioning primarily after expenditure has taken place.
